title: Cinna Dashboards — components
description: A dashboard component is a live, refreshable view an agent keeps for its owner: a folder `dashboards/<name>/` in the agent (contract 1.19.0), or `dashboards/<name>/` inside one of its skills. The folder name is the component's name; `component.json` describes it. A host shows components as tiles on the owner's dashboards and runs their endpoints only when someone is looking or the component asked at launch. This file is the contract for `component.json`, the data shapes a source returns, the endpoint convention, the page bridge and the component reference grammar. It defines no tool: an agent offers a component by printing its reference. `skills/cinna-dashboards/scripts/check_component.py` applies these rules; a host validating components applies the same ones and reports the same `x-check-codes`.

component_name.description: The component folder's name. There is no `name` field in component.json to drift from it.

duration_1m_or_more.description: A duration of at least 1m (60s). Failing only this pattern, not `duration`, is `while_open_every_too_short`.

component.description: `dashboards/<name>/component.json`. Unknown keys are preserved and ignored.

allOf.description: A .csv source file feeds a table view (`source_file_view`).
A .md source file feeds a markdown view (`source_file_view`).

description.description: One sentence on what the view shows.

view.description: `markdown`, `table`, `list` and `metrics` are native views the host draws in its own design from the shapes in `$defs/data`. `html` is the agent's own page, run in a sandbox with no network (see `x-web-view`).

entry.description: For `view: html` only: the page to open, relative to the component folder, ending in .html (lowercase). It must exist, and with symlinks resolved it must stay inside the component folder.

source.description: Where the view's data comes from: one of the component's endpoints, or a file in the agent folder.

file.description: Agent-relative path under `app-data/` (extension lowercase; with symlinks resolved it must stay inside the agent folder) (normally `app-data/dashboards/<name>/…`; for a skill's component `app-data/dashboards/<skill>/<name>/…`) or `files/`. A `.csv` feeds a `table`, a `.md` a `markdown` view, a `.json` any view. Re-reading a file costs nothing; `refresh.command` or `refresh.schedule` rewrites it.

endpoints.description: The component's endpoints by name. Only these may be run for it: as its `source`, or from its page with `cinna.call`.

script.description: Relative to the component folder, normally `api/<endpoint>.<ext>`, extension lowercase. Must exist, and with symlinks resolved it must stay inside the component folder. The extension picks the runtime (`x-endpoint-convention`).

description.description: What it returns and which params it reads.

params.description: Parameters the owner can change per tile. Native views draw controls for them; web views receive them in `ui/initialize`; the tile stores the current values; the source receives them on stdin.

default.description: Sent when the owner has chosen nothing. `enum`: one of `values`. `month`: `YYYY-MM` or `current`. `date`: `YYYY-MM-DD` or `today`. A host resolves `current` and `today` to a value before it runs the source, so an endpoint never sees the words.

refresh.description: When a host recomputes the tile. Nothing runs unless the tile is on screen, the owner presses Refresh, or the component asked at launch.

max_age.description: A visible tile whose cached result is older than this is recomputed. Never null: leave it out for the default.

while_open_every.description: Recompute on this period while the dashboard is on screen. At least `1m`.

after_turn.description: Recompute when this agent's turn ends and the tile is on screen. Without it the end of a turn only re-reads.

on_app_start.description: Warm up once after the app starts. It costs the owner at every launch: only for slow sources.

command.description: A `/run:<name>` command from docs/CLI_COMMANDS.yaml (the `status_refresh_command` grammar) run before the source is read: it rewrites the source file.

schedule.description: The `schedules[].name` whose output the source reads. For data that needs model judgment, such as ranking by the owner's rules; the tile re-reads what the schedule wrote.

size.description: On a 12-column grid: `s` 3×2, `m` 6×2, `l` 6×4, `wide` 12×2, `tall` 3×4. The owner can change it.

requires_credentials.description: Names from the agent manifest's `credentials[]` the source needs. A teammate without one sees "Needs the <name> credential" instead of a failed run. Every name must exist in the manifest.

context.description: How to read the view (units, what a row is, the order of stages), written for the owner's chat. Sent with the first context block of a chat.

prompts.description: Questions the owner can ask about the view, in the owner's language. They fill the dashboard chat; they never stream inside the tile.

data.description: What a source returns (stdout of an endpoint, or the content of a source file), per view. Any object shape may add `generated_at` (ISO 8601) and `notice` (one line, such as "Gmail token expired", shown as the tile's mark). `id`s make rows and items selectable and addressable in context; a missing `id` is a warning, not an error. `url` fields are drawn as links the owner clicks; only https, http and mailto.

table.description: A `.csv` source file is accepted too; its columns come from the header row.

html.description: Any JSON value; it is handed to the page through `cinna.onData`.

runtimes..py: python <script>, localized as commands are: `uv run python <script>` when the agent has a pyproject.toml; the host's managed uv. check_component.py --run without `uv` on PATH runs the checker's own Python and warns `uv_missing`.
runtimes..js: node <script>: the user's `node` when one resolves on the command's PATH, otherwise the host's own Node runtime (Cinna Desktop: Electron as Node). A host passes that runtime's path to tools it runs in `CINNA_NODE`; check_component.py --run uses `CINNA_NODE`, then `node` on PATH, and with neither warns `runtime_missing` and skips the run.
runtimes..ts: not yet: unknown extensions are refused.

x-endpoint-convention.node_dependencies: Built-ins and files in the agent folder. A package.json dependency works only when node_modules/ is already installed by the agent; a host never runs npm install.
x-endpoint-convention.cwd: The agent root, also for a component a skill ships.
x-endpoint-convention.environment: The agent's credential environment, the same as for /run: commands.
x-endpoint-convention.stdin: The params object itself (not wrapped): the tile's values, or each param's default with `current`/`today` resolved.
x-endpoint-convention.stdout: One JSON value. Logs go to stderr.
x-endpoint-convention.process_group: The endpoint runs in its own process group (POSIX session); at the timeout, past the stdout cap, and once it exits, the whole group is killed, so nothing it started outlives the run.
x-endpoint-convention.failure: A non-zero exit fails the run with the last 2,000 characters of stderr; the tile keeps its last good data and shows a mark. Stdout is read only up to max_stdout_bytes: past that the run is killed and fails.

x-web-view.sandbox: The page runs in a sandboxed frame whose CSP allows only the component's own files: no network, no CDN, no web fonts, no top navigation. Bundle every library into the folder and load it by relative path.

bridge.description: The host injects `window.cinna`, which speaks MCP Apps (2026-01-26) JSON-RPC over postMessage; Cinna-only methods are under `cinna/*`. Pages use the helper and never the wire.
bridge.cinna.ready: Promise of {component, title, params, theme, size}. Wire: ui/initialize + ui/notifications/initialized.
bridge.cinna.onData(cb): cb(data, {stale, fetched_at}): the cached result first, then the fresh one. Wire: ui/notifications/tool-result.
bridge.cinna.call(endpoint, params): Promise of one of this component's own endpoints' result, for drill-downs; not cached. Wire: tools/call.
bridge.cinna.setParams(params): Stored on the tile; the source recomputes and the result arrives through onData. Wire: cinna/params-changed.
bridge.cinna.setContext({summary, selection, vi: What the owner's dashboard chat sees about this tile; `selection` and `visible` are row or item ids. The last call wins. Wire: ui/update-model-context.
bridge.cinna.ask(text): Fills the dashboard chat's composer; never sends. Wire: ui/message.
bridge.cinna.openLink(url): Opens the default browser after the owner confirms the full URL. Wire: ui/open-link.
bridge.cinna.onTheme(cb): Light/dark changes. Wire: ui/notifications/host-context-changed. The host also sets CSS variables named `--cinna-*`; a page uses them with fallbacks, e.g. `var(--cinna-bg, #fff)`.

x-references.description: How any message names a component. A host renders a reference as a card that names the owning agent; rendering runs nothing. A reference inside backticks or a code block stays plain text.
forms: cinna://component/<agent>/<name>  — a component in the agent's dashboards/
cinna://component/<agent>/<skill>/<name>  — a component shipped in a skill the agent has

agent_segment.id:<manifest id>: The uuid in cinna-agent.json `id`. Survives folder moves and renames; teammates' copies keep it. What an agent prints when it has no bundle id.
agent_segment.bundle:<bundle_id>: The catalog id cinna-core mints when the agent is shared (e.g. `io.example.cinna.ab12cd34`). The same on every machine and for every teammate. Read from cinna-agent.json `bundle.bundle_id`, or from app-data/desktop.json `shared_remote.bundle_id`; the manifest wins when both exist.
agent_segment.<slug>: A bare manifest slug. Readable and typeable, but a folder rename breaks it. Accepted by a host, never printed by an agent.

x-references.prefix_rule: The prefix is always written: `bundle:` and `id:` are never guessed from the segment's shape. An agent prints the prefix its host's prompt gives it, never one it read from app-data/.
x-references.where_a_card_renders: A bare reference on a line of its own, or a markdown link whose target is a reference (the link text becomes the card's subtitle). Several references in one message render as a list of cards.
x-references.containment: A host resolves a reference to a kit agent on its machine and a folder under that agent's dashboards/ role or one of its skills' dashboards/. It is never a path.

x-skill-components.description: A skill may ship prebuilt components in `<skill>/dashboards/<name>/`, same layout, whether the skill is authored under skills/, from the catalog or from a marketplace. Other hosts ignore the folder.
x-skill-components.owner: The agent that has the skill: endpoints run with cwd at that agent's folder and with its credentials; data goes to the agent's app-data/dashboards/<skill>/<name>/. The same skill in two agents gives two components.
x-skill-components.read_only: The component is read from the skill's resolved folder (authored, catalog cache or marketplace cache) and writes nothing into it.
x-skill-components.updates: References follow the skill: updating it updates every tile; removing it leaves the tiles saying the component is gone.
x-skill-components.customising: To change a skill's component, copy it into the agent's own dashboards/, where it becomes the agent's and no longer follows the skill. Never edit a skill cache.

x-script-only-checks.description: Rules JSON Schema cannot express. Everything else check_component.py enforces is in this schema (patterns are matched against the whole string, extensions are lowercase, text a person reads is non-blank), so a schema-valid component.json fails only these. A host validating with the schema hand-codes them and reports the code given.

checks.rule: The component folder's name matches `$defs/component_name` (it is not a field of component.json).
A default fits its param's type: `enum` one of `values`; `month` YYYY-MM or `current`; `date` YYYY-MM-DD or `today`; `number` a number; `boolean` true/false; `text` a string. null means no default.
The script exists as a file.
The html entry exists as a file.
With symlinks resolved, a script and the entry stay inside the component folder and source.file inside the agent folder.
A component folder is not a symlink.
entry is only read for view html.
No page asset loads from the network.
No plain file directly in dashboards/.

x-script-only-checks.schema_failures: A schema failure reports the code x-check-codes gives for that field: `while_open_every` too short is `while_open_every_too_short`, other durations `duration_invalid`; a bad endpoint or param name `endpoint_name_invalid` / `param_name_invalid`; a script path `script_extension` when only the extension fails, else `script_outside_component`; source.file `source_file_extension` when only the extension fails, else `source_file_location`; a .csv/.md source with the wrong view `source_file_view`; source with neither, both or extra keys `source_invalid`; entry `entry_invalid`; refresh.command `refresh_command_invalid`; a missing required field `required`; a wrong JSON type `invalid_type`; anything else `invalid_value`.

x-check-codes.description: Stable finding codes. check_component.py prints `path: message` lines and, with --json, {path, code, field, severity, message}. `path` is agent-relative; `field` is the component.json field (map keys written literally, e.g. `endpoints.deals.script`) or, for a result, the data field with array indices dropped (`items.title`).

errors.not_a_directory: the path is not a folder
errors.not_in_dashboards: the folder is not dashboards/<name>/ of an agent or a skill
errors.component_name_invalid: the folder name breaks the component name pattern
errors.component_json_invalid: component.json is not one JSON object
errors.invalid_type: a field has the wrong JSON type
errors.invalid_value: a field is out of its enum, range or length
errors.script_outside_component: a script path is absolute or leaves the component folder
errors.symlink_escape: a script or entry resolves outside the component folder, or source.file outside the agent folder, through a symlink
errors.component_symlink: a component folder is a symlink (never followed)
errors.source_invalid: source names neither or both of endpoint and file
errors.unknown_endpoint: source.endpoint is not a key of endpoints
errors.source_file_location: source.file is not under app-data/ or files/
errors.source_file_view: a .csv with a view other than table, or a .md with a view other than markdown
errors.entry_invalid: entry is not an .html path inside the component
errors.entry_missing: the html entry does not exist
errors.duration_invalid: a refresh duration does not parse
errors.credential_unknown: a requires_credentials name is not in the manifest's credentials[]
errors.run_failed: --run: the endpoint exited non-zero, timed out or could not start
errors.run_output_invalid: --run: stdout is not one JSON value, or is over 5 MB
errors.shape_invalid: --run: the result does not fit the view's shape

warnings.script_location: an endpoint script is outside api/
warnings.entry_ignored: entry on a view other than html
warnings.refresh_command_unknown: refresh.command names no command in docs/CLI_COMMANDS.yaml
warnings.refresh_schedule_unknown: refresh.schedule names no schedule in the manifest
warnings.manifest_missing: no cinna-agent.json above the component, so credentials were not checked and --run did not run
warnings.runtime_missing: --run: no node (CINNA_NODE or PATH) for a Node endpoint, so it was not run; a host uses its own Node
warnings.uv_missing: --run: the agent has a pyproject.toml but no uv is on PATH, so the endpoint ran with the checker's Python and may fail on imports
warnings.network_reference: a page asset loads something from the network
warnings.stray_file: a plain file directly in dashboards/
warnings.source_file_unwritten: --run: the source file does not exist yet
warnings.id_missing: --run: a row or item has no id, so it cannot be selected
